questions.q: Who is the original Green Goblin's secret identity?
questions.why: Norman Osborn is the first and best-known Green Goblin.

questions.q: Which actor played the Green Goblin in Sam Raimi's Spider-Man films?
questions.why: Willem Dafoe played Norman in Raimi's trilogy and returned in No Way Home.

questions.q: Which of Peter Parker's girlfriends dies at the Goblin's hands in Amazing Spider-Man #121-122?
questions.why: The Goblin kills Gwen in 'The Night Gwen Stacy Died' (1973).

options: Gerry Conway and John Romita Sr.
Roger Stern and John Romita Jr.
questions.why: Stan Lee scripted and Steve Ditko drew the Goblin into being.

questions.q: In which issue of The Amazing Spider-Man did the Green Goblin debut?
After the death of Peter's girlfriend, which member of the original Goblin's family took up the Goblin identity?
questions.why: Writer Gerry Conway had Harry, Norman's son, become the second Goblin.

questions.q: Which villain did Roger Stern introduce to take over as Spider-Man's archenemy?
questions.why: Roger Stern introduced the Hobgoblin as Spider-Man's new archenemy.

questions.q: Under optimal conditions, how much weight can the Goblin Formula let the original Goblin lift?
questions.why: The Goblin Formula grants superhuman strength, up to about nine tons at best.

questions.q: In which issue, the first after the co-creating artist left, is the Goblin unmasked?
questions.why: Ditko left after #38, and #39 revealed Norman as the Goblin.

questions.q: What did the Green Goblin ride in his debut, before switching to the bat-shaped glider?
questions.why: In The Amazing Spider-Man #14 he flew a steel, wingless broomstick with a rocket motor; the bat glider arrived two issues later.
